Mono8px — 8x8 pixel font
Assembled by fangzhangmnm (re-vectorised outlines, metadata, toki pona glyphs).

Provenance of the glyphs
  - Hanzi: identical bitmaps to "GuanZhi 8px" (观致 8×8 像素字体), which is based on Misaki
    (美咲フォント, by Num Kadoma / Little Limit) with GB2312 hanzi added.
  - GuanZhi is distributed under the same terms as Misaki (as stated on the font
    listing pages; the font file itself only names "Misaki" in its copyright field).

Misaki font license (original text):
  These fonts are free software.
  Unlimited permission is granted to use, copy, and distribute them, with or without
  modification, either commercially or noncommercially.
  THESE FONTS ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY.

The additions by fangzhangmnm are released under the same terms.
